title: Current ACIS comparator limits and ModelDocViewStyle evidence boundary
mode: Current primary project/API source review plus local source and plan audit
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Reassess whether newly screened downstream readers add independent DWG, DXF, or 3D semantic evidence.
Bound cq-acis as a potential external ACIS parser/converter by its published SAT/SAB profiles and limitations.
Cross-check Autodesk view-style property semantics against LibreDWG field documentation and local PAR-138 storage.
Refine existing PAR-07/S8 and PAR-138 implementation/evidence gates without adding local findings or support claims.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source review and local source/plan reconciliation
localEvidence: src/drw_objects.h and src/drw_objects.cpp DetailViewStyle/SectionViewStyle models and parsers
Existing generated PAR-138 ASCII/Binary typed-value, raw replay, high-bit, unnamed-boolean, and hatch-angle controls
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md prior peer-lineage, ACIS, FreeCAD, and PAR-138 crosswalks
method.limitations: The reviewed GitHub main/master and Autodesk API pages are mutable and were not pinned to source commits or executed artifacts. LibreDWG's published OBJECTS field inventory is generated for 0.13.4; the separately reviewed current src/objects.in class registry is mutable main. The ODA v5.4.1 PDF text search found no DetailViewStyle/SectionViewStyle class-name entry, which bounds this edition's available evidence but does not prove no later ODA material exists. cq-acis documentation is an experimental project scope statement, not a run or universal ACIS guarantee. No result qualifies a native CAD application, arbitrary DWG/ACDSDATA association, or support claim.

uncadRouteBoundary.dwgRoute: Vendored locally patched LibreDWG via Rust FFI; not an independent DWG parser vote beside LibreDWG.
uncadRouteBoundary.dxfRoute: Separate undxf parser for ASCII/Binary DXF, including documented R2007+ coverage; candidate only for a named pinned DXF-read comparison.
uncadRouteBoundary.semanticCeiling: Project caveats describe 3DSOLID/REGION and mesh-family output as approximate isometric wireframes; experimental type coverage is not real-file qualified in the cited document. Rendering is not B-rep semantics or source-record preservation.

cqAcisProfileBoundary.sat: Documented save versions 105, 400, 600, and 700, with explicit geometry/profile limits.
cqAcisProfileBoundary.sab: Documented ACIS BinaryFile 21800 and selected ASM versions 22000, 22300, 22600, 22700, 22900, and 23200; 8-byte framing is synthetic-only.
cqAcisProfileBoundary.conversion: Parsing does not imply conversion. Unsupported records remain raw; shape conversion is limited to listed analytic and experimental spline/tolerance profiles with source-precision checks.
cqAcisProfileBoundary.independence: Parser source lineage is distinct from libdxfrw, but CadQuery/OpenCascade is shared with the FreeCAD kernel family. It does not establish DWG AcDs extraction/owner association or native application acceptance.

viewStyleEvidence.autodeskApi: DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle expose named semantic properties. SectionViewStyle HatchAngles are radians, cycle for later components, and require at least one angle; these references do not define DWG flag bit positions or identify repeated group-290 fields.
viewStyleEvidence.odaSpec: The public v5.4.1 PDF text search returned no DetailViewStyle, SectionViewStyle, or hatch_angles entry; no class-specific semantic flag crosswalk can be attributed to this edition.
viewStyleEvidence.libredwg: The published 0.13.4 OBJECTS inventory exposes raw flags, two SectionViewStyle unknown booleans, and angle count/vector fields; current mutable objects.in marks both style classes STABLE. This is peer field/class evidence, not normative ODA layout evidence or writer/root-graph qualification.
viewStyleEvidence.local: Local models preserve style fields, aggregate flags, and both repeated SectionViewStyle booleans. Existing generated ASCII/Binary tests prove storage/copy/raw-replay for tested values, not every semantic mapping or real-producer DWG decode.
